name: 国保税の所得割額などを改定
summary: 国分寺市国民健康保険条例を改正します。子ども・子育て支援納付金に関する規定を整え、国民健康保険税の所得割額などを改定します。
changes: 子ども・子育て支援納付金に関する規定を整える
国民健康保険税の所得割額などを改定する
who: 国民健康保険税を納める人
why: 地方税法の改正に伴う規定の整備と、国民健康保険税の所得割額などの改定が必要なためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Revises the income-based portion of National Health Insurance tax and other amounts
en.official: Regarding an Ordinance Partially Amending the Kokubunji City National Health Insurance Ordinance
en.summary: Kokubunji City will amend its National Health Insurance Ordinance. It will update provisions related to the Children and Childcare Support Contribution and revise the income-based portion of National Health Insurance tax and other amounts.
changes: Update provisions related to the Children and Childcare Support Contribution
Revise the income-based portion of National Health Insurance tax and other amounts
who: People who pay National Health Insurance tax
en.why: The city says this is necessary to update provisions following amendments to the Local Tax Act and to revise the income-based portion of National Health Insurance tax and other amounts.
